targets.authors: Banerjee, P., Chatterjee, P., & Sinha, J.
targets.title: Is it light or dark? Recalling moral behavior changes perception of brightness.
targets.replication_study_numbers: Study 1 online, Study 1 lab, Study 2 online, Study 2 lab
targets.evidence_quote: We replicated BCS Studies 1 and 2 using the original methods from BCS that were provided to us by the original authors.
targets.outcome_quote: Despite conducting high powered replication studies of BCS, we were unable to replicate the original effects in our own replication studies. Recalling ethical or unethical behavior did not have an effect on the estimated brightness of the room, the estimated watts of light in the room, or the preference for light-emitting products.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall failure verdict about the four own replications. Meta-analytic evidence from other studies is distinguished from their own null results.
